scope: Actual egglog runtime, release, single sampled runs; ground import + selective binding indexes. Not a memory comparison at equal progress for interrupted runs.

cumulative_top_rules.rule:
(rule ((NeedLocalPort i port)
       (= port (ParentPort k j sort))
       (LinkedParent i k p)
       (OutputAt p j v)
       (= v (V sort key)))
      ((LocalResolved i port v))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedLocalRoute i ports)
       (= ports (RCons p tail))
       (LocalResolved i p v)
       (LocalArgs i tail args))
      ((LocalArgs i ports (ACons v args)))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((LinkedParent i k p)
       (Provides p e))
      ((Provides i e))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedList i es)
       (= es (ECons e tail))
       (Satisfies i e)
       (AllSatisfied i tail))
      ((AllSatisfied i es))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((= i (Occurrence id c))
       (ParentAt i k p)
       (= p (Occurrence pid pc))
       (ParentTemplate c k pc))
      ((LinkedParent i k p))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedEffect i e)
       (= e (RowFact row))
       (Provides i e))
      ((Satisfies i e))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedLocalRoute i (RCons p tail)))
      ((NeedLocalPort i p)
       (NeedLocalRoute i tail))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((= i (Occurrence id c))
       (LocalRoutes c ports)
       (LocalArgs i ports args))
      ((Binding i args))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedPartialRoute i ports)
       (= ports (PCons p tail))
       (PartialResolved i p v)
       (PartialArgs i tail args))
      ((PartialArgs i ports (ACons v args)))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedList i (ECons e tail)))
      ((NeedEffect i e)
       (NeedList i tail))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeededParentPort i k j sort port)
       (LinkedParent i k p)
       (TypedOutputAt p j sort v))
      ((LocalResolved i port v))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedLocalRoute i ports)
       (= ports (RCons p tail))
       (LocalResolved i p v)
       (LocalArgs i tail args))
      ((LocalArgs i ports (ACons v args)))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((LinkedParent i k p)
       (Provides p e))
      ((Provides i e))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((OutputAt p j v)
       (= v (V sort key)))
      ((TypedOutputAt p j sort v))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedList i es)
       (= es (ECons e tail))
       (Satisfies i e)
       (AllSatisfied i tail))
      ((AllSatisfied i es))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((= i (Occurrence id c))
       (ParentAt i k p)
       (= p (Occurrence pid pc))
       (ParentTemplate c k pc))
      ((LinkedParent i k p))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedEffect i e)
       (= e (RowFact row))
       (Provides i e))
      ((Satisfies i e))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedLocalRoute i (RCons p tail)))
      ((NeedLocalPort i p)
       (NeedLocalRoute i tail))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((= i (Occurrence id c))
       (LocalRoutes c ports)
       (LocalArgs i ports args))
      ((Binding i args))
        :ruleset tier1 )

(rule ((NeedPartialRoute i ports)
       (= ports (PCons p tail))
       (PartialResolved i p v)
       (PartialArgs i tail args))
      ((PartialArgs i ports (ACons v args)))
        :ruleset tier1 )
